# Course

This repository contains the materials for the course *Generalized Linear Models* from the PhD program in Psychological Sciences (University of Padova). The repository is organized as an R Package.

<center>

{{< qrcode https://github.com/stat-teaching/GLMphd >}}

</center>

## Getting Started

To start with the course you can download or clone the entire Git repository. Simply run `git clone link` or download the repository directly using this [link](https://downgit.github.io/#/home?url=https://github.com/stat-teaching/GLMphd).

If you downloaded the folder you need to unzip it. Then you can open the `GLMphd.Rproj` file and R Studio will be opened on the correct folder. From now, everything is organized as a R package. To load all the custom function of the `R` folder and datasets (`data` folder) you can use `devtools::load_all()`. This is the same as doing `source("file.R")` without cluttering the global environment.
